# S6.3a — multi-family code search and hosted coordinates (`research-grade`) (§05h R-2.9.5 6c · R-2.8.5²)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s6.2` (PR #93) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands Stage 6c — the evolution campaign grows from one automated family
to a closed multi-family set, gains `CompiledPayload` code-search
candidates, the `rebase` moved-head leg, `voi`/`concentrate` slot
allocations, hosted-coordinate admission over `hh-hosting/1`, and the
model-install `authority_cap` ceiling. Every research family is
`research-grade` by construction and seals `preview` only.

**Closed family set + the research-grade wall.** `PROPOSER_FAMILIES =
{ahe, rho, gene_bank, code_search}`; the three research families
mandate `maturity_flags ∋ "research-grade"` at spec validation, and an
S8 seal on a research-grade campaign accepts only
`label = "preview"` — a research result never enters a committable
acceptance row (ADR-0323 D1; AC-R-2.9.5-5; CC9).

**Multi-class campaigns.** `target_classes[]` joins `target_class`:
`ahe` campaigns still refuse anything beyond `{target_class}` (the 6b
one-class rule holds); research families may name several members of
`EVOLVABLE_TARGET_CLASSES`, which now includes `code_payload`
(`CompiledPayload` bodies — typed, declared-interface-bearing,
out-of-process).

**The three research-family variants.** `RhoProposer` — retrospective,
trajectory-anchored: declares `needs_reference_trajectories = yes`,
refuses corpora without the layer, and anchors the emitted hypothesis
to the reference trajectory. `GeneBankProposer` — quality-diversity
archive over the declared classes; each `propose` addresses the
least-covered niche. `CodeSearchProposer` — emits a `ReplaceLeaf` diff
rewriting an `Opaque` step's `bytes_hash` under the *same*
`declared_interface` (the interface is the contract; bytes are
content-addressed, never embedded). All three stay deterministic +
CPU-only, emit `Candidate`/`Hypothesis`/`NoAddressableFailure` (never
`[]`), and re-enter the campaign's S1 gates like any source.

**`rebase` — the moved-head leg.** A post-S4 candidate (`searched` /
`validated` / `transferred` / `security_checked`) rebases onto the
current lineage head: `base_ref` must equal the head (`StaleBase`),
the rebased diff's semantic-op target set must equal the stored
diff's, and apply/invert/`validate` re-run on the new base (the same
`OpaqueWithoutInterface` mapping as S1). `rebased` re-enters at S5 —
nothing downstream survives the move — and the `transitioned` row
carries `rebase{of, onto}` so the fold rebuilds byte-identically.

**Hosted coordinates via `hh-hosting/1` (the C4→C2 edge, ADR-0196
D7).** `hosted_descriptor_refs` resolve `HostedCoordinateDescriptor`
bodies through `LabDocs` — records-in, never a hosting API call. At
`open`, every declared `hosted_coordinates` member must resolve
`capability = supported` under `abi = hh-hosting/1` +
`participant_class = hosted` (`HostedCoordinateUnsupported` /
`UnresolvableEvidence`). At S1, `coordinate_values` are scalar-only
(a structured value is a structural coordinate edit — refused), must
name an admitted coordinate, and must be `enforced` under
`budget_enforcement` — `reported_only` is `ReportedOnlyDimension`
(AC-15). A hosted campaign declaring `reported_only_dimensions` still
refuses `IncommensurableMatch` at open.

**Install under `authority_cap` (R-2.8.5²).** `CandidateProposal.
install{name, kind, requested_grants[]}` is gated at S1 — no declared
cap or a grant outside it is `AuthorityWidening`.
`EvolutionCampaign::install` re-checks the cap, then delegates to the
registry's `install_plan` (its `AuthorityWidening` /
`ModelInstallDenied` map through as campaign refusals, never
swallowed); `security.extension.install_requested` mints on the
campaign run before any fetch.

**Slot allocation `voi`/`concentrate`.** Both carry
`floors{slot → min_share_ppm}` (sum ≤ 1_000_000 —
`BudgetSplittingTrap`); every floor names a declared slot. `voi`
campaigns must declare the `slot_history` corpus layer — the only
admissible VOI input (ADR-0190's scheduler seam).

**Boundary + ledger.** `lab.evolution.rebase` joins Group L
(`serves_measurement`, experimental, EVO_ERR — `{run, candidate_id,
proposal, base_doc}` → `{state: "rebased"}`); the schema, compat
matrix and generated client are regenerated through `hh-codegen`.
`TRANSITION_FIELDS` grows `target_ref` / `rebase` / `coordinates` /
`install` (append-only, CC8).
